_comment: Extra calendar event flags per Fortnite build, e.g. "10.31": ["EventFlag.SomeEvent"]. Names must match the game's own flags exactly; a wrong name does nothing. 10.31: LTE_BlackMonday is the Fortnite x Batman crossover (Gotham City). Gotham City is turned off: add "EventFlag.LTE_BlackMonday" to 10.31 to switch the client back to the Batman event.
